title: Where I've built things
sub: Roles across AI, backend, and research — the most recent first.

bullets: Shipped retrieval-augmented generation systems to production, owning the pipeline from ingestion to serving.
Built evaluation loops that caught regressions before they reached users.
Worked across the model and the backend infrastructure that serves it.
Designed and maintained APIs and data pipelines handling production traffic.
Improved reliability and latency of core services under load.
Collaborated with the ML team to wire models into the serving stack.
Researched retrieval and evaluation methods, implementing ideas from first principles.
Contributed to work that became a published paper (see Publications).
